entities.title: The table screen names an old address for the scores
entities.summary: The in-game table says SCORES AT GAMES.ICELANDER.NET; the scores page is at icelander.net/games/retro/hivestorm/scores/.
entities.expected: The title screens' table points players to where the public scores page is served: icelander.net/games/retro/hivestorm/scores/, as the README and the Worker's route have it.
entities.observed: drawTable() writes SCORES AT GAMES.ICELANDER.NET under the table. The Worker's only route is icelander.net/games/retro/hivestorm*. Whether games.icelander.net still answers, or redirects, was not checked.
acceptanceCriteria: The table screen names an address that serves Hivestorm's scores page, in the 224 px the screen has.

origin.description: Found while documenting Hivestorm's folders: drawTable's footer line against wrangler.jsonc's route.
